diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~40% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.423), which favours a weighted combination.

decision.justification: Selected 'trimmed_mean on pool2' (a seeded deterministic baseline) as the best of 22 backtested attempts, score -0.1776. Series context: trend strength 0.9584 and seasonal strength 0.9077; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.423); 8 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 7.987.
